import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

interface Application {
  commandBus: { execute: (command: { name: string }) => Promise<string> };
}

async function arrange(): Promise<{ application: Application; saved: string[] }> {
  const saved: string[] = [];
  const application: Application = {
    commandBus: {
      execute: async (command) => {
        saved.push(command.name);
        return command.name;
      },
    },
  };
  return { application, saved };
}

describe('PlaceOrderHandler', () => {
  let world: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof arrange>>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    world = await arrange();
  });

  it('places an order', async () => {
    const result = await world.application.commandBus.execute({ name: 'place' });
    expect(result).toBe('place');
    expect(world.saved).toEqual(['place']);
  });

  it('saves nothing when the command is refused', async () => {
    const { application, saved } = await arrange();
    await application.commandBus.execute({ name: 'refused' });
    expect(saved).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
